en: Black‑and‑white image of a large villa or hotel with a prominent multi‑storey lookout tower rising above a steep tiled roof. The building is surrounded by tall coniferous trees, suggesting a forest setting. In the foreground is a terraced outdoor garden or beer garden with many white chairs and tables arranged in rows, separated by low hedges and bordered by a wooden fence. Several people in early‑20th‑century clothing are visible among the tables.
